spec.name: Dwarf Blacksmith at the Anvil
spec.description: A stocky Warcraft-style dwarf blacksmith, hammer raised overhead in one fist and tongs gripping a glowing bar in the other, working at an iron anvil on a wooden stump over a soot-blackened stone forge floor.
spec.layout: The dwarf stands centred at x=0 facing +Z, feet on the floor at z≈-0.3, a chunky 1.15 m figure with a huge head, a braided copper-red beard to mid-chest, an iron helmet with brass trim, a blue tunic under a heavy leather smithing apron and short sturdy legs in iron-toed boots. His right arm (model -X) is raised high behind his head gripping a big smith hammer with a steel head at y≈1.6, mid-swing; his left arm reaches forward so the tongs in his hand grip a glowing orange bar lying across the anvil face. Directly in front of him at z≈0.42 sits the anvil station: a wooden stump, the iron anvil with its horn pointing +X, the ember-hot bar on the face, and scattered tools (a spare hammer head, a horseshoe, tongs) leaning against the stump. Everything rests on a low stone flagstone forge floor box (z from -0.55 to 0.62) with dark grout seams, soot stains around the anvil, spilled coal lumps and hairline ember cracks glowing near the stump. Style: bold faceted low-poly shapes with chunky exaggerated proportions (head ≈1/3 of the dwarf, beard and helmet as the identity cues), flat colours read warm at the fire (ember, stump, beard, brass) against cool iron, steel and stone, and every detail - braid rings, rivets, boots, anvil plate, gauge of the hammer - is a small part in its own colour seated on the surface. The only glow comes from the bar, the ember cracks and spilled coals.

parts.builds: The stone forge floor the whole scene stands on: a low platform of large bevelled flagstone blocks (stone top, stoneDark sides) fitted in a rough grid with visible dark grout seams as thin recessed strips. Heavy soot and scorch staining (soot-coloured thin flat patches) around and under where the stump sits, plus a few hairline ember cracks (thin glowing ember strips) radiating toward the anvil. Spilled coal lumps (small faceted coal chunks) and one or two ember sparks (tiny ember/emberHot cubes glowing) scattered near the stump. A couple of moss-grey worn corners on the far edges for age. Faceted, chunky, deliberately uneven block edges.
parts.attaches: Rests on the floor at y=0; the anvilStation stump and the dwarf's boots both stand on top of its surface, meeting mounts floorLevel and stumpSeat.

parts.builds: The anvil station in front of the dwarf at z≈0.42: a wooden stump (stump with stumpDark bark rings on top, faceted cylinder) rising from the forge floor to y=0.42 at mount stumpSeat, and on it the iron anvil - a chunky low-poly body (iron) with a steel face plate (steel) as a thin top slab, a thick tapered horn pointing +X, a waisted waist under the face and a small ironLight base plate with brass pins. Across the face at mount anvilFace lies the glowing workpiece: a short iron bar turning ember at its middle and emberHot at the heated centre, with 2-3 tiny emberHot sparks. Leaning against the stump and lying on the floor nearby: a spare hammer head, a small horseshoe (iron), a second pair of tongs (ironLight) and a couple of coal chunks. This part owns the bar at barCenter; the armsTools tongs grip its ends.
parts.attaches: Stump foot meets forgeFloor at floorLevel/stumpSeat; anvil sits on stumpSeat; the glowing bar lies on anvilFace at barCenter where armsTools' tongs meet it.

parts.builds: The dwarf's trunk and legs: short sturdy bowed legs with chunky iron-toed boots (iron with ironLight toe caps and steel soles) planted on the forge floor at z≈-0.3, thick thighs in dark trousers (belt colour), a broad barrel torso (tunic) with tunicTrim collar edging and a chest strap, all wrapped in a heavy leather smithing apron (apron with apronDark scorched patches and burn holes near the waist, one small ember spark mark) that hangs from chest to knees, and a wide tooled belt (belt colour) with a big brass buckle and hanging tool loops. Massive trapezoid shoulders and short thick neck base under the helmet; the silhouette is a squashed barrel - wider than deep, arms bulging where they leave the shoulder sockets at mounts shoulderL and shoulderR.
parts.attaches: Boots rest on forgeFloor top; the torso top meets dwarfHead at mount neckBase; the shoulder sockets at mounts shoulderL and shoulderR are where armsTools' arms begin.

parts.builds: The dwarf's head - the hero of the model, oversized: a broad ruddy-skinned face (skin) with a huge bulbous nose, deep-set small eyes (dark pupils in skin-shadow sockets with heavy ironLight bushy brows above), rosy cheek blocks, and small pointed ears sticking out from under the helmet. A great braided beard (beard with beardDark under-shadows) in three thick braids, each braid a tapered chain of chunky segments bound with gold rings, split by a moustache over the mouth; the jaw is a separate lower jaw piece under the moustache so it can open. The iron helmet (iron) sits low over the brow with a steel band (steel), a brass nose-guard and rivets, two short bone horns at the sides and a brass finial stud on the crown. Everything keyed off a single head-scale constant so brow, eyes, nose, braids and helmet stay in place.
parts.attaches: Sits on the neck at mount neckBase riding joints neck, head and jaw; the beard's lower braids overlap the chest of dwarfBody.

parts.builds: Both arms with their tools: short massive arms in tunic sleeves with rolled leather bracers (apronDark with brass studs), big four-fingered blocky fists (skin). The right arm (model -X) rises from mount shoulderR up behind the head to handR, gripping overhead a huge smith hammer: a long wooden haft (stump colour) running up to a massive steel head (steel with ironLight face bevel and a brass wedge) at y≈1.6, angled for a downswing toward the anvil. The left arm reaches forward-down from mount shoulderL to handL near the anvil, holding iron tongs whose jaws close around the ends of the glowing bar at mount barCenter, posed so the tongs meet the bar exactly where anvilStation built it. Wrists, knuckles and thumb blocks are separate small parts; elbow and shoulder transitions are chunky.
parts.attaches: Arms spring from mounts shoulderL and shoulderR on the dwarfBody torso; the left tongs grip the glowing bar at mount barCenter on the anvilStation anvil face.
